class Teacher:
    def __init__(self):
        self._myStudents = []

    def getMyStudent(self, index):
        return self._myStudents[index]

    def getMyStudents(self):
        return tuple(self._myStudents)

    def numberOfMyStudents(self):
        return len(self._myStudents)

    def hasMyStudents(self):
        return len(self._myStudents) > 0

    def indexOfMyStudent(self, aMyStudent):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._myStudents) if x is aMyStudent), -1)

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfMyStudents():
        return 0

    def addMyStudent(self, aMyStudent):
        if any(x is aMyStudent for x in self._myStudents):
            return False
        existingTeacher = aMyStudent.getTeacher()
        isNewTeacher = existingTeacher is not None and existingTeacher is not self
        if isNewTeacher:
            if not aMyStudent.setTeacher(self):
                return False
        else:
            self._myStudents.append(aMyStudent)
        return True

    def removeMyStudent(self, aMyStudent):
        if aMyStudent.getTeacher() is self:
            return False
        index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._myStudents) if x is aMyStudent), -1)
        if index >= 0:
            del self._myStudents[index]
        return True

    def addMyStudentAt(self, aMyStudent, index):
        if not self.addMyStudent(aMyStudent):
            return False
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfMyStudents():
            index = self.numberOfMyStudents() - 1
        del self._myStudents[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._myStudents) if x is aMyStudent), -1)]
        self._myStudents.insert(index, aMyStudent)
        return True

    def addOrMoveMyStudentAt(self, aMyStudent, index):
        if not any(x is aMyStudent for x in self._myStudents):
            return self.addMyStudentAt(aMyStudent, index)
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfMyStudents():
            index = self.numberOfMyStudents() - 1
        del self._myStudents[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._myStudents) if x is aMyStudent), -1)]
        self._myStudents.insert(index, aMyStudent)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        for i in range(len(self._myStudents), 0, -1):
            aMyStudent = self._myStudents[i - 1]
            aMyStudent.delete()
